analyzed_vuln.description: Heap use-after-free caused by incorrect ownership transfer of the decoded ExtensionObject typeId. In ExtensionObject_decodeBinary(), when encoding==UA_EXTENSIONOBJECT_ENCODED_BYTESTRING, it calls ExtensionObject_decodeBinaryContent(dst, &binTypeId, ctx) and then unconditionally UA_NodeId_deleteMembers(&binTypeId). But ExtensionObject_decodeBinaryContent() may take the 'unknown type' path and assign dst->content.encoded.typeId = *typeId (shallow move/copy of NodeId including string bytes). Freeing binTypeId immediately then leaves dst->content.encoded.typeId pointing to freed memory. Later UA_copy/NodeId_copy reads that dangling string buffer, triggering UAF in UA_Array_copy memcpy.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In fuzz_binary_decode, input is decoded via UA_decodeBinary into a type containing nested ExtensionObjects/Variants. Trigger requires an ExtensionObject with ENCODED_BYTESTRING whose typeId is not recognized (so ExtensionObject_decodeBinaryContent stores it as encoded blob) and whose NodeId uses dynamically allocated identifier data (e.g., string/bytestring). ExtensionObject_decodeBinary then frees binTypeId, but dst retains alias to freed buffer; subsequent deep-copy in tortureEncoding (UA_copy on decoded object) dereferences freed NodeId string data and crashes.
